completeness.why: Every site now passes its own enable flag and mode, under its own field names, to getDateWithWeekendRule, which decides whether and how to move the date; the outer skipWeekend ternaries are gone. getNextDate combines its raw skipWeekend with noSkipWeekend, an option only that site has, which the rubric allows to stay at the site. The template sites' day-string parsing and formatting is their own data handling.

interface.why: (date, skipWeekend, solveMode) carries exactly the real variation, has no speculative options, and leaves each caller to map its own field name (weekendSolve vs weekendSolveMode). A positional boolean is a mild readability cost, and the getNextDate-only noSkipWeekend is folded into that flag at the call site rather than named.
